messages:
Ravi (Content): kicking off OSS refapp launch thread. goal: 1) short launch post for OSS blog 2) reproducible micro-benchmarks + notebook 3) 30-min 'build-with' webinar + gated repo. timeline: two weeks.
Lena (DevRel): sounds good. we should prioritize a tiny tutorial (5 steps) that users can run in ~10min locally. repo should include docker + github actions.
Priya (Growth): inbound flow: landing page -> HubSpot form -> tag list 'oss-refapp-launch'. want UTM utm_campaign=oss-refapp and utm_source=social. can we require company and checkbox for "enterprise interest"?
Lena (DevRel): yep. minimal form fields: email + github handle + use-case (textarea) + enterprise interest checkbox. sending to /webhooks/hubspot-v2.
Carlos (Engineering): benchmark plan: compare stock model vs our optimized serving profile across 128/512 contexts. will capture median, p95, and tokens/sec. I'll provide a runbook + reproducible script. initial quick run shows ~3.4x tokens/sec at 128.
Noah (Designer): I'll make a launch hero, two social images, and a one-pager PDF cheat sheet. need a one-line stat to highlight. Carlos, can you confirm final number by EOD Thurs?
Carlos (Engineering): will validate. sharing quick command now:
```bash
PYTHONPATH=. python -m benches.run --model tuned --seq 128 --iters 100 --out bench_128.json
```
Ravi (Content): draft headline ideas: a) "Run the Redwood Refapp: fast, local, open" b) "Ship a latency-aware refapp in 10 minutes" c) "Open refapp + microbenchmarks: see the numbers" prefer concise.
Priya (Growth): option a for socials, option c for blog meta. will prep promo slots: announce, reminder, and day-of.
Ivy (Sales): can we add a hidden field to the form that flags accounts >100 employees so sales gets higher-priority leads? we can look up company size via Clearbit after submit.
Lena (DevRel): yes, we can enrich after submit. will add Slack alert to #sales-leads with the tag.
CI-Bot: github action triggered: draft-repo/ci.yml check started. status: success.
Ravi (Content): repository gating: we want the repo public but with a gated 'enterprise-playbook.pdf' behind a form. landing page will link to repo + notebook.
Priya (Growth): follow-up cadence: immediate email with repo link + notebook, 48h email with benchmark highlights + CTA to webinar recording, 7d email for sales outreach if enterprise checkbox set.
Noah (Designer): card copy options for highlight metric: "3.4x tokens/sec (128)" or "p95 latency down 40%". Carlos, which is more robust?
Carlos (Engineering): use tokens/sec for the hero, p95 in blog body. final validated numbers tomorrow morning.
Lena (DevRel): action items: 1) repo + actions (me) 2) benchmark script + notebook (Carlos) 3) landing page + form wiring (Priya) 4) hero + social assets (Noah) 5) launch post draft (Ravi) 6) enrichment + sales alerts (Ivy). please drop status in the doc.
Ravi (Content): I'll draft the blog with a short methodology section and link to a reproducible Colab. will ask for a short code snippet for the blog.
Carlos (Engineering): snippet for blog:
```python
from refapp.bench import Runner
runner = Runner(model='tuned', seq_len=128, runs=100)
print(runner.summary())
```
Priya (Growth): tracking: will create HubSpot list 'oss-refapp-launch-YYYYMM' and set utm rules. also request social ads budget approval after metric confirmation.
Ivy (Sales): will prepare a short playbook for leads tagged enterprise-interest and >100 employees. want a 2-day SLA to reach out.
Noah (Designer): \u2705 sharing first drafts tomorrow.
Lena (DevRel): \u2705 repo skeleton ready on staging.
Carlos (Engineering): \u2705 bench script initial run complete, will validate and upload bench_128.json.
Priya (Growth): \u2705 landing page draft up in staging, form wired to hubspot test endpoint.
Ravi (Content): thanks team. quick asks: Carlos please confirm final hero stat by EOD, Noah export one social card as square and landscape, Priya keep the utm naming consistent. will post a review doc link in 2h.
CI-Bot: reminder scheduled: launch-check in 3 days.
Ravi (Content): ending note: keep messages short in this thread. we'll move final signoffs to the google doc. link: https://docs.google.com/oss-refapp-launch-draft
